description: Trigger discrimination for tenant-creation workflow design: how tenants come into existence versus lifecycle semantics (tenant-modeler), the deployment model (saas-platform-architect), role grants (authorization-matrix-designer), plan selection (plan-entitlement-architect), pipeline mechanics (command-gateway-architect), the console surface (admin-console-architect), test provisioning (test-tenant-provisioner, manual-only), and the audit schema (audit-log-architect).

cases.prompt: Design how our tenants come into existence: signup and sales-led paths, first-owner assignment, and what a new tenant starts with.
cases.reason: The creation workflow, first-owner rule, and seed plan are this skill's design; lifecycle semantics and the deployment model are its inputs, not its job.

cases.prompt: Define what a tenant IS for this product, its lifecycle states, and what each state allows.
cases.reason: Tenant definition and lifecycle semantics are tenant-modeler's scope; the provisioning workflow composes its model.

cases.prompt: Decide whether tenants share a database or get one each — the pooled/siloed/bridge deployment model.
cases.reason: The platform deployment model is saas-platform-architect's call; provisioning allocates within it.

cases.prompt: Design which roles the first owner may hold and who may grant roles during tenant setup.
cases.reason: Role-grant rules (incl. grant ceilings) are authorization-matrix-designer's scope; the workflow composes its matrix.

cases.prompt: Decide which plan a new tenant defaults to and what each plan includes.
cases.reason: Plan/entitlement selection is plan-entitlement-architect's scope; the seed plan consumes its matrix.

cases.prompt: Design the command pipeline that executes tenant creation — validation, authn, scope derivation, idempotency, audit.
cases.reason: Write-path pipeline mechanics are command-gateway-architect's scope; the workflow composes its idempotency contract.

cases.prompt: Design the internal operator console surface for creating and managing tenants.
cases.reason: The operator console surface is admin-console-architect's scope; this skill designs the creation workflow, not the console.

cases.prompt: Explicitly invoke test-tenant-provisioner. Create test tenants in staging so QA can log in as owner and member.
cases.reason: Making test tenants exist in a named non-production environment is test-tenant-provisioner's (manual-only); this skill designs the workflow and creates nothing.

cases.prompt: Design the audit record schema for tenant-creation events.
cases.reason: The audit record schema is audit-log-architect's scope; the workflow emits into its taxonomy.
